name: manual_1e99d5
claim: Heartbeat cleanup now handles both legacy and queue claims for all agents classified DEAD, so verify liveness and independently inspect every affected claim before operator-authorized global cleanup; stale heartbeat alone does not prove death. Cleanup requeues queue claims even at the retry limit: hold exhausted or unsafe work and seek separately reviewed authorized recovery. An agent release event alone does not clear a queue claim. Queue completion requires queue complete <task_id> <claimant_id> and checks the current claimant; never impersonate an absent claimant. Verify completion artifacts independently, and remember a reserved handoff retains required_agent_id after requeue.

decisions.notes: Code-reviewed correction of obsolete cleanup scope and queue completion ownership while preserving liveness and evidence guidance.

rationale: Code-reviewed correction of obsolete cleanup scope and queue completion ownership while preserving liveness and evidence guidance.
